name: qa-superteam
description: An autonomous AI quality engineering team: risk-based QA skills, real test execution, evidence capture, independent verification and a deterministic release gate.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-first QA: audits, PR review, bug verification and release gates
interface.longDescription: QA Superteam makes the agent work like a QA team: it discovers what the software should do, ranks risks, runs your real tests, investigates and independently verifies failures, and decides PASS, REVIEW_REQUIRED or BLOCK from an explicit policy.
defaultPrompt: Run a full QA audit of this repository.
Is this branch safe to release?
